part2.question: A special cake you received from others

segments.v: I want to talk about a special cake from my best friend Linh. It was my 16th birthday last year. In the evening, she came to my house with a cake. She made it herself. The cake looked like my film camera. It was black and silver and it had a lens made of chocolate. She also wrote a message on it. It was special because Linh can't bake but she tried very hard. Her first cake was broken so she made another one until 2 am. She knows I love photography. The cake was also very delicious. I took a photo of it and I still keep it. I think it is the best gift because she made it with her heart.

grammar.band6: “Her first cake was broken so she made another one until 2 am” (collapsed; stayed up until 2 am making another).
grammar.band9: Past perfect (My family had planned…; she'd baked…), past continuous (Linh was standing there, holding…), a what-clause (What made it so special was…), and relative clause (the one object that sums up my biggest hobby).

analysis.keyDifference: Band 6 “Her first cake was broken so she made another one until 2 am” is unnatural (collapsed; stayed up until 2 am making another). Band 9 builds a surprise, describes the cake precisely, explains the effort behind it, and ends with humour.
